chunks: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) used to eat the leek with the grained salt.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali eat with leeks?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Al-Kafi highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) simple dietary practice of eating leeks with grained salt, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of consuming humble, readily available foods. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on moderation and the spiritual value found in everyday sustenance, aligning with the broader Islamic ethic of avoiding extravagance.

en.hubeali: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat the leak with the grained salt’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “
’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would eat leeks with not so finely powdered salt.’”
